verses.original: לְ֭זֹאת לִבִּ֑י אַף־ יֶחֱרַ֣ד וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·zōṯ lib·bî ’ap̄- ye·ḥĕ·raḏ wə·yit·tar mim·mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה יֵצֵֽא׃ מִפִּ֥יו
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū šā·mō·w·a‘ bə·rō·ḡez qō·lōw wə·he·ḡeh yê·ṣê mip·pîw
verses.literal: Listen closely . . . to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling [that] comes from His mouth

verses.original: יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ תַּֽחַת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם עַל־ כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·rê·hū wə·’ō·w·rōw ta·ḥaṯ- kāl- haš·šā·ma·yim ‘al- kan·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו׀ יִשְׁאַג־ ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ בְּק֣וֹל וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי־ קוֹלֽוֹ׃ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw yiš·’aḡ- qō·wl yar·‘êm gə·’ō·w·nōw bə·qō·wl wə·lō yə·‘aq·qə·ḇêm kî- qō·w·lōw yiš·šā·ma‘
verses.literal: Then there comes a roaring sound He thunders with His majestic voice He does not restrain [the lightning] when His voice resounds

verses.original: אֵ֣ל יַרְעֵ֤ם נִפְלָא֑וֹת בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl yar·‘êm nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ bə·qō·w·lōw ‘ō·śeh ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·lō nê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: God thunders wondrously with His voice He does great things we cannot comprehend

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֹאמַ֗ר לַשֶּׁ֨לַג׀ הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם עֻזּֽוֹ׃ מִטְר֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: kî yō·mar laš·šɛ·laḡ hĕ·wê ’ā·reṣ wə·ḡe·šem mā·ṭār wə·ḡe·šem ‘uz·zōw miṭ·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: For He says to the snow Fall [on] the earth and to the gentle rain . . . Pour out a mighty downpour

verses.original: יַחְתּ֑וֹם בְּיַד־ כָּל־ אָדָ֥ם כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י לָ֝דַ֗עַת מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·tō·wm bə·yaḏ- kāl- ’ā·ḏām kāl- ’an·šê lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: He seals up the hand of every man so that all men may know His work

verses.original: חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ־ וַתָּבֹ֣א אָ֑רֶב תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃ וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yāh ḇə·mōw- wat·tā·ḇō ’ā·reḇ ṯiš·kōn ū·ḇim·‘ō·w·nō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: The wild animals . . . enter their lairs they settle down in their dens

verses.original: סוּפָ֑ה תָּב֣וֹא מִן־ הַ֭חֶדֶר קָרָֽה׃ וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: sū·p̄āh tā·ḇō·w min- ha·ḥe·ḏer qā·rāh ū·mim·mə·zā·rîm
verses.literal: The tempest comes from its chamber and the cold from the driving north winds

verses.original: מִנִּשְׁמַת־ אֵ֥ל קָ֑רַח יִתֶּן־ מַ֣יִם וְרֹ֖חַב בְּמוּצָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: min·niš·maṯ- ’êl qā·raḥ yit·ten- ma·yim wə·rō·ḥaḇ bə·mū·ṣāq
verses.literal: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen

verses.original: אַף־ יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב בְּ֭רִי יָ֝פִ֗יץ אוֹרֽוֹ׃ עֲנַ֣ן
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- yaṭ·rî·aḥ ‘āḇ bə·rî yā·p̄îṣ ’ō·w·rōw ‘ă·nan
verses.literal: - He loads the clouds with moisture He scatters His lightning through them

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת׀ מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בְּתַחְבּוּלָתוֹ לְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mə·sib·bō·wṯ miṯ·hap·pêḵ bə·ṯaḥ·bū·lå̄·ṯō lə·p̄ā·‘o·lām kōl ’ă·šer yə·ṣaw·wêm ‘al- pə·nê ṯê·ḇêl ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: They swirl about whirling at His direction accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth

verses.original: אִם־ לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם־ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם־ יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃ לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד
verses.transliteration: ’im- lə·šê·ḇeṭ ’im- lə·’ar·ṣōw ’im- yam·ṣi·’ê·hū lə·ḥe·seḏ
verses.literal: Whether for punishment or for His land . . . He accomplishes this in His loving devotion

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן׀ נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nāh zōṯ ’î·yō·wḇ ‘ă·mōḏ wə·hiṯ·bō·w·nên nip̄·lə·’ō·wṯ ’êl
verses.literal: Listen to this O Job stand still and consider the wonders of God

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם בְּשׂוּם־ עֲנָנֽוֹ׃ א֣וֹר וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯê·ḏa‘ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ‘ă·lê·hem bə·śūm- ‘ă·nā·nōw ’ō·wr wə·hō·w·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: Do you know how God . . . dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash

verses.original: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל־ עָ֑ב מִפְלְשֵׂי־ מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯê·ḏa‘ ‘al- ‘āḇ mip̄·lə·śê- mip̄·lə·’ō·wṯ tə·mîm dê·‘îm
verses.literal: Do you understand how the clouds float those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים אֶ֝֗רֶץ בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט מִדָּרֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- bə·ḡā·ḏe·ḵā ḥam·mîm ’e·reṣ bə·haš·qiṭ mid·dā·rō·wm
verses.literal: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind

verses.original: עִ֭מּוֹ תַּרְקִ֣יעַ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw tar·qî·a‘ liš·ḥā·qîm ḥă·zā·qîm kir·’î mū·ṣāq
verses.literal: can you, like Him spread out the skies as strong as a mirror of bronze

verses.original: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־ נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א־ נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nū mah- nō·mar lōw lō- na·‘ă·rōḵ mip·pə·nê- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: Teach us what we should say to Him we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness

verses.original: הַֽיְסֻפַּר־ ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם־ אִ֝֗ישׁ אָ֥מַר כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hay·sup·par- lōw kî ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’im- ’îš ’ā·mar kî yə·ḇul·lā‘
verses.literal: Should He be told that I want to speak . . . Would a man ask - to be swallowed up

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר ה֭וּא בָּהִ֣יר בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lō rā·’ū ’ō·wr hū bā·hîr baš·šə·ḥā·qîm wə·rū·aḥ ‘ā·ḇə·rāh wat·tə·ṭa·hă·rêm
verses.literal: Now no one can gaze at the sun [when] it [is] bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean

verses.original: מִ֭צָּפוֹן יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה זָהָ֣ב נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד׃ עַל־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ye·’ĕ·ṯeh zā·hāḇ nō·w·rā hō·wḏ ‘al- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: Out of the north He comes in golden [splendor] awesome majesty surrounds Him

verses.original: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא־ מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־ כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב־ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šad·day lō- mə·ṣā·nu·hū śag·gî- ḵō·aḥ ū·miš·pāṭ wə·rōḇ- ṣə·ḏā·qāh lō yə·‘an·neh
verses.literal: The Almighty is beyond our reach He is exalted in power In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים יְרֵא֣וּהוּ לֹֽא־ יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל־ חַכְמֵי־ לֵֽב׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ă·nā·šîm yə·rê·’ū·hū lō- yir·’eh kāl- ḥaḵ·mê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Therefore men fear Him for He is not partial to the wise in heart
